mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, version_no, version_name, status, effective_time, remark, create_time, update_time FROM dms_commission_rule_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, tenant_id, version_no, version_name, status, effective_time, remark, create_time, update_time FROM dms_commission_rule_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY effective_time DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tenant_id, version_no, version_name, status, effective_time, remark, create_time, update_time FROM dms_commission_rule_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_commission_rule_version (tenant_id, version_no, version_name, status, effective_time, remark) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{versionNo}, #{versionName}, #{status}, #{effectiveTime}, #{remark})
